changeNote: First release in the yaah pack.
name: diff-review
description: Review a change in this chat's git repository, read live with git.diff (no diff text goes through you): a file list with status, +/− and viewed ticks, one file at a time (tabs when narrow), j/k files, n/p hunks, v viewed. Per file and hunk the user can ask about it or ask for a change or revert (drafted into their message box, never applied), copy, and open the file in their editor. Use it to show what you changed, a branch against main, or the staged changes, instead of pasting a diff or a --stat.

range.description: What to compare, e.g. "main...HEAD" (this branch) or "HEAD~1". Omit for the working tree (staged and not) against HEAD.

staged.description: Only the staged changes (index against HEAD).

paths.description: Only these paths, relative to the chat's folder.

title.description: What the change is, e.g. "Refunds: this branch against main".
